text:
Maria Gonzalez: quick sync — draft PRD for Optimize Toolkit (batching / caching / quant recommendations). Need acceptance criteria, edge cases, and scope pushback before Friday. TL;DR: ship as beta for Hosted + Dedicated, not Private on day 1. Thoughts?

Ajay Rao: 👍 agree with beta scope. High-level acceptance: measurable token-cost delta <10% regression on 90p latency; config rollback with a single flag; documented model-specific heuristics. Need a canary plan + SLIs for quality.

Casey Lin: Edge cases to call out: short-prompt workloads where batching harms p95 latency; KV-cache staleness for long-lived streaming sessions; quantized variants that break exact-match tests for codegen. Recommend per-route opt-out + explicit disable for streaming endpoints.

Olivia Park: Testing plan idea: run synthetic traces + 3 anonymized customer traces (search, chat, codegen). Automated evals: unit evals (perplexity/regression), downstream correctness suites, and manual spot-checks. I can own infra harness and dashboards.

Maria Gonzalez: can we put the acceptance criteria into 3–5 bullets in the PRD? Also decision needed: do we ship auto-applied quantization or only recommend suggested profiles?

Ajay Rao: start with recommendations + telemetry-driven hints. No auto-change without explicit human approval. Suggestions should include thresholds (e.g., cost reduction >5% & no quality regression across eval set).

Casey Lin: Draft acceptance bullets: 1) >=2x batch throughput improvement for models with avg sequence > 2k tokens in steady-state; 2) <=5% drop in eval quality metrics (task-specific); 3) feature flags + rollout API + circuit-breaker behavior documented and tested. Add a short 'Limits & Known Fallbacks' section for edge cases.

Olivia Park: example rollout config (for PRD snippet):
```yaml
optimize:
  batching: on
  batch_max_tokens: 4096
  quant_profile: suggestion_only
  rollback_on: ['regression:quality', 'latency:increase']
```

Maria Gonzalez: noted. One customer ask from BigRetail: deterministic outputs for billing flows — must have per-route opt-out + enhanced audit logs (KMS) for those routes. Ajay, can you log that as a prioritized sales/cs ticket?

Ajay Rao: logged: #CS-1987 (BigRetail deterministic requirement). Also :point_up: on recommendations-only approach for quant.

Ajay Rao: @Olivia can you estimate infra + cost for a 1-week canary (3 customer traces + synthetic)?

Olivia Park: rough estimate: 3 days infra setup + ~$2k/week for canaries (GPU hours + storage for traces). Will confirm with infra after lunch.

infra-bot: deploy:pr-452 opened for repo optimize-toolkit/rfc — CI checks passing.

Maria Gonzalez: plan: I'll update the PRD with acceptance bullets, edge cases, the sample rollout config, and responsibilities. Ping owners for content by Wed EOD. Next sync Thurs 10:00am. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

Casey Lin: ack — I'll draft the rollback playbook + test matrix (including short-prompt tests).

Ajay Rao: LGTM. +1 to suggestion-only quant and per-route opt-outs.

Olivia Park: :thumbsup: will follow up with cost numbers and canary run playbook.
